purpose: Single predeclared sensitivity test of forecast destination ranking when VM CPU sizes vary, addressing the homogeneous physical-slot constraint. No search over size patterns.
sizes: VM index even=1PE, odd=2PE; 1000MIPS per PE; RAM2048MB,BW1000,storage10000 unchanged. Cloudlet PE equals its VM; per-PE job length unchanged.
controls: Same five fixed trace cases, host counts, VM counts, 24h window and job mix. Shared current-demand source/destination best-fit packing; only LR forecast arm ranks destinations by frozen per-VM CPU forecast.
limitations: Total CPU capacity requested and total job MI differ from original uniform-VM benchmark, so energy levels cannot be compared directly as a model gain. Physical slot audit based on identical sizes is not applicable here.
acceptance: compare all five cases and costs
no reserved traces or parameter tuning
report negative or null result without trying new size patterns
